purpose: whole adopted Kicad_PowerOpt pipeline on power_module with pcb-analysis main against the exp/cpp-multiphysics-dc-emc branch; the consumer-side measurement of the fused C++ paths of the electro-thermal coupling

kicad_poweropt.ref: origin/main as cached on 2026-09-25 (fetch unavailable, remote may be ahead)

environment.command: python -m plane_opt.application.run --root . --results-root <run> --boards power_module --board-settings-dir work/bench/settings --skip-kicad-validate --kicad-cli <stub that exits 1> --bootstrap-orders 1 --parallel-physics-scenarios --parallel-multiscale-contours --copper-parasitics screen --radiation-report screen --keep-previous-runs
environment.board_settings: board/power_module/.plane_opt/board.json plus thermal_coupling {enabled: true, gate: report} and geometry_interface {authoritative: grid}
environment.geometry_interface_note: the STEP default needs kicad-cli for the fixed-world export; kicad-cli is absent on this host so the grid interface was selected per board
environment.kicad_validate: skipped (kicad-cli absent); the run therefore reports the 03 stage as failed and exits 2 in both cases
environment.hardware_counters: unavailable (KVM guest); wall, user and sys from bash time
environment.runs_serialised: no other benchmark ran during either run

candidate.thread_layout: nine scenario threads (physics_scenario_workers auto) times three OpenMP threads per native call on 32 cores
notes: the sheet PEEC current field runs the uniform-grid convolution operator, not the pFFT operator, so _sheet_pfft_native is not exercised
Kicad_PowerOpt does not import the emc package, so PCB_NATIVE_EMC has no effect in this run
geometry native kernels are only used by the STEP interface, which was off

candidate_before_fma_fix.note: same results; excluded from the decision because its DC kernel formed the corner weights with an FMA and is not the shipped one (see MATRIX_FREE_MPIR_FEM.md)

thermal_coupling_standalone.definition: evaluate_thermal_coupling on the full-domain copper of every role, 9 configured cases, physics_scenario_workers auto (9), 0.1 mm grid, same overlay as the run; wall time of the call
thermal_coupling_standalone.dc_native_share_of_the_gain: 5.5 s of the 27.2 s thermal-only time

decision.criteria: same candidate (masks, areas, all-case ratios, thermal rise) from both runs and a shorter wall time with no other benchmark running
decision.scope: kept opt-in through native=True or the PCB_NATIVE_* flags on the exp branch; merging into pcb-analysis main is a separate feature/ step, and Kicad_PowerOpt passes no native arguments itself
